svg.aria-label: ix-board reads Linear into a SQLite snapshot that expires after 5 minutes. Four command groups read that snapshot: ready queue, focus, program review, and agents and drift. GitHub pull requests and Herdr agent panes are read directly by the commands that need them. Every command prints text or JSON, and the Claude Code and Codex plugin skills read the JSON.
